scope: Four completed lifecycle demonstrations: mode switching, actual connection-error retry, failed-job stop in both modes. This is separate from the 30 experiment runs; not a blanket pass of all assessment checks.
faults_disclosed: For retry, a temporary local forwarder deliberately closed real status-GET connections; successful responses came from the unchanged Go app. For failure, only a newly uploaded demo copy was temporarily renamed; the real worker recorded failed and the copy was restored.
cancellation_limit: Forwarder can retain an upstream request after the browser aborts; backend cancellation resource cleanup is not established by these captures.
recording_format: GIF animations made from time-sampled native Firefox job-panel screenshots. Capture timestamps and individual PNGs are included; white padding only equalises frame sizes. Not full-frame-rate screen video.
interrupted_attempt: session-20261027-094831 was interrupted during its third case; only its first two fully verified cases are included. The failure cases are from completed session-20261027-095236. Original attempts remain preserved separately.
